title: Panels and captions number and style themselves
body:
A figure's sections are `group` nodes with a title written as two `text` nodes at hand-picked offsets, such as `text { at 40 0; text "{grey 4}   ..."; style title; }` in `key-schemes.acre`. Nothing numbers them, and every figure restates the same title style.

## Proposal

- `panel NAME { title "..."; ... }`: a group with a heading. Panels number themselves 1, 2, 3 in source order. A canvas-level style sets how a panel heading looks, with an optional frame and background.
- `caption { text "..."; width N; }`: text set in the caption style, under its panel or under the whole figure.
- A panel reports its size, measured from what it holds, so the layout issue can stack panels.

## Open

- Whether the number is part of the title text or a separate mark, and whether `panel` replaces `group` or wraps it.
close_reason: Panels, captions and kind styles landed in d696f9e. The rework into cards is uncommitted on dev: a framed panel's at is its frame's corner, its heading and contents sit inside padding, and width and height set the least frame size. A stack or grid now measures a child's lines, arrows and braces when their names resolve. figures/key-schemes.acre draws its five sections as white cards on a grey page.
